question: Who among the following Musicians was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bhupen Hazarika**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bhupen Hazarika **

 
 
• **Bhupen Hazarika**, better known by his stage name Xudha kontho, was an** Indian playback singer, lyricist, musician, poet, actor, and filmmaker who was born in Assam on September 8, 1926**. 
 
• His songs, which he wrote and sang mainly in** Assamese, are characterised by humanism and a sense of universal brotherhood**.
 
• They have been translated into various languages and performed, most notably in **Bengali and Hindi**.
